bio: One of those restaurants that everyone has something good to say about... and no wonder, it is run with kindness by the chef-owner and his wife, a tandem that reflects the perfect marriage between the dining room and the kitchen. It occupies a family home dating from the early 20th century and has a rustic-regional atmosphere in the dining room, with a multitude of decorative details, exposed beams and a fireplace that is usually lit. The three menus (El Pantanet, Cava la Font and El Teix) are based on the typical recipes of the region, but with a twist to make them lighter, more attractive and more modern. Try the Croquette sampler or the Al-Andalus baked shoulder of lamb!...
